findings.title: Automated fresh-run stops before the expected Spirit Severing cap

evidence.result: releaseReady=false; normal route final realm was soul_formation instead of spirit_severing

findings.why_it_matters: A tutorial cannot safely teach current campaign truth when the authoritative fresh-run report does not reach the expected content cap.
findings.suggested_fix_direction: Decide whether Spirit Severing is the current playable cap, then repair the route or adjust the acceptance contract.

linear_draft.title: Fresh-run acceptance stops at Soul Formation instead of Spirit Severing

findings.title: Balance and route timing probes fail before Foundation entry

evidence.result: fail; Timing probe ended without milestone: foundation_entry

evidence.detail: throws when required cumulative milestones are missing

findings.why_it_matters: First-gate, first-prestige, and second-life pacing cannot be measured reliably while the route probes cannot reach Foundation entry.
findings.suggested_fix_direction: Repair the timing probe setup or the underlying transition conditions, then regenerate balance measurements.

linear_draft.title: Timing probes fail before Foundation entry

findings.title: Fresh life-start allows live Qi and Breakthrough Ready before identity completion
reproduction: Observe Qi and Breakthrough state under the path wizard

evidence.detail: Fresh path overlay showed Path No Path selected, Qi over cap, and Breakthrough Ready

findings.why_it_matters: The first tutorial beat would be teaching identity while the mechanical loop already advances without that identity.
findings.suggested_fix_direction: Gate cultivation ticking and breakthrough actions until life-start path, Heart Law, and breath are completed, or explicitly explain the pre-life state.
